description: This file defines the class DBCPConnectionFactory, which is responsible for creating and managing database connections using Apache Commons DBCP. It implements connection pooling, manages data source caching, and handles connection configuration including driver loading, pooling parameters, and transaction integration.

classes.name: DBCPConnectionFactory
classes.description: A connection factory implementation using Apache Commons DBCP for connection pooling, supporting transaction-aware data source management and configurable pool settings.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a pooled database connection based on provided helper info and JDBC configuration, including driver instantiation, pool setup, and transaction integration.

methods.name: closeAll
methods.description: Clears the connection pool cache, effectively closing all data sources managed by this factory.

methods.name: getDataSourceInfo
methods.description: Returns diagnostic information about a specific cached data source identified by helper name.
